1. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a plurality of network nodes of a local contention neighborhood of a random access network, wherein a first node is configured to transmit to a second node at an access attempt percentage, and wherein each of the **plurality of network nodes** is configured to provide an indicia of its inter-node interference to **at least one other node of the plurality**, and wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage to transmit to the second node based on one of the provided indicia.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference is based on a minimum desired throughput for **the first node and the second node.**

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on the indicia of inter-node interference of the first node **relative to** an indicia of inter-node interference of **at least one other node** interfered with by transmissions from the first node.

14. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising the first access point, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast **a dynamic weight associated with the second node to the first node, the dynamic weight determined based on transmission conditions between the second node and at least one other node.**

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point, wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and the first node **is capable of introducing interference to communication between the second node and the second access point through varying access attempt percentages.**
